About this item

  • Compatible with Nintendo Switch 2’s new GameChat mode
  • HD lighting adjustment and autofocus: The Logitech webcam automatically fine-tunes the lighting, producing bright, razor-sharp images even in low-light settings. This makes it a great webcam for streaming and an ideal web camera for laptop use
  • Advanced capture software: Easily create and share video content with this Logitech camera that is suitable for use as a desktop computer camera or a monitor webcam
  • Stereo audio with dual mics: Capture natural sound during calls and recorded videos with this 1080p webcam, great as a video conference camera or a computer webcam
  • Full HD 1080p video calling and recording at 30 fps. You'll make a strong impression with this PC webcam that features crisp, clearly detailed, and vibrantly colored video
  • This web camera for desktop computers comes with a 3-month XSplit VCam license and no privacy shutter. XSplit VCam lets you remove, replace and blur your background without a green screen
  • Fully compatible with Windows 11

From the manufacturer

Logitech HD Pro Webcam C920X

Chat and Record Like A Pro

Call, stream, blog and record like a pro in crystal clear HD video and audio. With spectacular video quality up to HD 1080p and dual built-in mics, C920X makes it a breeze to make your video presence stand out from the crowd. C920X comes with a free 3-month premium XSplit license.

Previous page

  1. High-Def Video Chat

    Connect with everyone in Full HD 1080p on Skype, or in fluid HD 720p on most popular video calling apps. Even chat with Facebook friends with video calling powered by Skype or Facebook Messenger.

  2. Full HD 1080p Video Recording

    Record vibrant HD 1080p video clips that capture the smallest details. Get fast, smooth uploads with less demand on your computer.

  3. Clear Stereo Audio

    Make sure everyone hears the real you. Two microphones, one on either side of the webcam, capture natural stereo audio.

  4. Premium HD Glass Lens

    The Full HD, five-element glass lens captures razor-sharp, clear images, while the premium autofocus adjusts smoothly and precisely to provide consistent high definition.

  5. Automatic low light correction

    Stream clear video, even in dim light. Video automatically adjusts to accommodate shadowy or harsh lighting conditions.

Next page

System Requirements

Compatible with Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10 or later, and most video calling applications

Works in USB Video Device Class (UVC) mode with:

macOS 10.6 or later (HD 720p on FaceTime for Mac or other supported video-calling clients; Full HD 1080p video recording with QuickTime Player), Chrome OS, Android v 5.0 or above (with supported video-calling clients), and USB port

Product guides and documents

User Manual (PDF)

Product Description

Polished, Full HD video calls. The C920x Pro HD Webcam with microphone delivers remarkably crisp, clear, and detailed images in vibrant colors. This USB camera for PC features HD autofocus and light correction, adjusting to the conditions to provide consistently high definition, while the five-element glass lens delivers razor-sharp images. Dual mics, placed on either side of the lens, capture the natural sound of your voice, making it great as a webcam for PC or a webcam for Mac. The 3-month XSplit VCam license enables you to remove, replace, and blur your background. Whether for a key Skype call, to demo your skills, or create your next YouTube video, the C920x ensures you make a strong impression.This Logitech webcam can be used as a laptop camera, streaming camera, or computer camera with a microphone for desktop setups, enhancing your video conferencing or content creation experience.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Surprisingly good quality for the price
    I honestly wasn’t expecting much from this little webcam, but I’ve been pleasantly surprised by how good it looks once plugged in. The video quality is clear enough for Zoom calls, online classes, or everyday use, and setup was very simple. My laptop camera quality is terrible, so this was a noticeable upgrade right away. I also like that it clips securely onto the top of the screen and doesn’t feel bulky. The picture looked smoother and brighter than I expected for a budget-friendly webcam. I love how it folds up and is very adjustable. Overall, this ended up being a great little camera for the price and works well for basic streaming, meetings, and video chats.

      4 out of 5 stars
      Well-designed, well-built, well-supported
      Reviewed in the United States on December 25, 2020
      Size: 1 PackStyle: 1080P/30 fps, 720p/30fpsPattern: Webcam
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I bought one of these for my wife after using one myself for several years. I teach online so my camera gets constant use. The image quality is terrific, especially after using the setup software to increase the camera resolution. The camera is plug-and-play, requiring no setup in either Windows or Ubuntu Linux. The only minor complaints I have are that images are dim in low light (make sure your face is well-lit from the front!) and that it occasionally re-focuses spontaneously and causes a few seconds of blurred video. But 99 percent of the time the image is excellent.

      Audio quality is very good too, but the microphone can be overdriven, causing distorted sound. This is seldom a problem for voice calls but if you're using it for something louder like an acoustic instrument you should turn down the microphone gain in either the camera setup or the application itself, and make sure from the person on the other end that they're not hearing distortion. With the mic properly set you get decent audio fidelity, no matter what your sound source is.

      My biggest complaint about this webcam has nothing to do with the device itself. It's too popular. It's almost always sold out at the Logitech store, and when they do make some available, they are snapped up by resellers who scalp them at a $15-$30 premium. It would be helpful if Logitech would limit the number people could buy to give more people a chance to get this great camera at a more reasonable price.

      I'd been streaming my gameplay for a while and decided it was time to add a facecam so my viewers could see my live reactions. After seeing the Logitech C920x recommended everywhere, I decided to give it a shot, and I'm so glad I did. For any gamer looking to add a personal touch to their stream, this webcam is the perfect starting point.

      Image quality is crisp and clear. The Full HD 1080p resolution is more than enough for the typical facecam window in a stream layout. The 30fps is smooth and doesn't lag, easily keeping up with my reactions to jump scares or big wins.

      The real star of the show is the HD Light Correction. My game room isn't professionally lit—it's usually just the glow from my monitors and a single lamp. The C920x handles this low-light situation brilliantly. It automatically adjusts to make sure my face is well-lit and clear. I didn't have to buy expensive key lights or ring lights to look good on camera, which saved me a ton of money.

      Setup was a breeze. It was literally plug-and-play. I plugged the USB into my PC, and my streaming software (OBS) recognized it instantly. There was no messing with drivers or complicated settings. Within five minutes, I had it positioned on my monitor and added to my stream layout.

      If you're a streamer looking to show your reactions and engage more with your viewers. This camera is Highly recommended.
